chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who prays the first two rakʿahs of the obligatory prayer and does not sit in them until he bows. He said: He completes his salat, then gives salām, and performs the two sajdahs of forgetfulness while seated before speaking.

key_terms.سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ: the two prostrations performed for forgetfulness in prayer
key_terms.يُسَلِّمُ: he gives the closing salām of prayer

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if they forget the first tashahhud and remember only after bowing in the third rakʿah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets the first tashahhud and only remembers after going into rukūʿ of the third rakʿah. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that the person should complete the salat, then after salām perform the two sajdahs of forgetfulness before speaking.
